what:
KEDGE v35 flight check (11 Nov 2026): flight34.py's model unchanged, run on the folded out35 geometry (pods hinged at x 50, folded
aft along the flanks) with the line tied in the tail face (x 152, z -2.4, on the hull), against the final v34 (out34, same tail tie).
  .venv/bin/python flight35.py            -> phys35/flight35.json
conventions: aoa / sideslip = angle of the velocity from the body axis, + when the nose is below (pitch) the flight path; body_pitch_at_impact = nose direction below (-) the horizon; path_deg_down = flight path below the horizon at impact; nose_first = |aoa| (or |sideslip|) under 45 deg for the whole flight (flight_sim.py's test)
